defects.title: Any non-empty legacy journal action bypassed a missing canonical receipt
defects.root_cause: custody_reconcile.go accepted action != "" as coverage, including unverifiable-legacy and unknown dispositions
defects.fix: Typed LegacyDisposition state machine (COVERED_VERIFIED / UNRESOLVED / CONTRADICTION) with independent binding checks

defects.title: LegacyJournalAction swallowed every database error as 'no classification'
defects.root_cause: migration.go returned ("", nil) for any Scan error instead of distinguishing sql.ErrNoRows
defects.fix: sql.ErrNoRows is the only not-found result; all other errors propagate with context

defects.title: Quarantined unverifiable-legacy rows were treated as covered and advanced the high-water mark
defects.root_cause: reconcile skipped every journaled row before verifying the disposition
defects.fix: UNRESOLVED/CONTRADICTION preserve REPAIR_REQUIRED and return before AdvanceObligationHWM

defects.title: Witnessed-legacy classification was coverage without a verified acknowledgement
defects.root_cause: coverage verification never re-verified the recorded ack against the custodian trust set
defects.fix: ResolveLegacyCoverage requires a custodian-signed ack binding the unchanged envelope, sequence, execution, deployment, and family

defects.title: Compensating a legacy row changed its envelope hash without updating successor links
defects.root_cause: CompensateLegacyRow updated one row's envelope_hash/envelope_json and re-signed only that row
defects.fix: MigrateLegacySuffix rewrites the target and every successor's previous_checkpoint_hash and signature in one transaction; VerifyChain proves the result

defects.title: Migration had no preflight for witnessed or checkpointed suffixes
defects.root_cause: No successor/ack/checkpoint examination before rewriting
defects.fix: MigrationPreflight refuses a witnessed target, any witnessed successor, a checkpoint covering the suffix, a missing checkpoint row, or a contradictory checkpoint head; refusal quarantines the chain

defects.title: Migration was not crash-safe, fenced, or replayable, and preserved no before/after proof
defects.root_cause: No transaction-wide preflight, no migration hook coverage, no signed proof record
defects.fix: Single immediate transaction, in-transaction preflight, signed custody-migration-proof-v1 before/after evidence, idempotent replay, and fault-injection seams

defects.title: OperatorRepair succeeded with no full-history scanner installed
defects.root_cause: the scanner was invoked only when present (`if ok && fn != nil`) and absence was treated as success
defects.fix: OperatorRepair returns ErrRepairScannerUnavailable when no scanner is installed

defects.title: A caller-supplied actor name plus the ordinary evidence signer authorized repair
defects.root_cause: OperatorRepair took actor string and required only non-empty; custodyctl used -signer-key as authority
defects.fix: Detached OperatorGrant signed by a separately pinned repair-authority key; subject is signature-bound; deployment, role, operation, window, and nonce are verified

defects.title: Repair marker clear was not transactional and could erase a newer contradiction
defects.root_cause: ClearRepairRequired read status, then unconditionally set the marker empty
defects.fix: ClearRepairRequiredIfUnchanged compares the exact reason the scan observed inside the write transaction and returns ErrStaleRepairVerification on change

defects.title: No grant expiry, single-use nonce, or durable replay fence
defects.root_cause: authorization was a static key possession with no per-operation grant
defects.fix: RFC3339 not_before/expires_at, >=16-byte nonce consumed in operator_nonce_ledger, grant digest bound into journal and audit evidence

defects.title: Documented subcommand-first custodyctl syntax failed
defects.root_cause: global flag.Parse stopped at the subcommand; trailing flags became positional arguments
defects.fix: Per-subcommand flag.FlagSet parsing; status/inspect/preflight/migrate/rescan/repair accept flags after the subcommand

defects.title: Inspection materialized the entire outbox and journal
defects.root_cause: Pending() and MigrationJournal() were unbounded
defects.fix: PendingPage / LegacyRowsPage / MigrationJournalPage use SQL cursor pagination with bounded page sizes; text mode streams pages; JSON output is capped by -limit/-page-size

defects.title: Sandbox catalog verification followed symlinks and ignored unsafe ancestors
defects.root_cause: DeploymentPosture used os.Stat and checked only the final directory
defects.fix: Lstat refuses a symlink catalog; ancestor walk refuses non-root symlinks, group/other-writable non-sticky directories, and foreign-owned directories; canonical path is used for the runtime

defects.title: Same-UID catalog replacement was invisible
defects.root_cause: Posture re-check accepted whatever directory sat at the path
defects.fix: Catalog dev/inode/uid identity is captured and re-checked at posture time and immediately before deletion; replacement is IDENTITY_UNVERIFIABLE

defects.title: Inspect-then-delete race had no second identity check
defects.root_cause: Cleanup classified the occupant once, then issued rm
defects.fix: A second bounded inspection plus catalog re-check runs immediately before delete; substitution is IDENTITY_MISMATCH and no rm is issued

defects.title: Cleanup had no crash-recovery record for an in-flight destructive step
defects.root_cause: The removal obligation existed only in caller memory
defects.fix: Durable cleanup intent is written before rm and cleared only on an obligation-resolving outcome; PendingCleanupObligations exposes unresolved intents

defects.title: Sync heartbeat raced the exec stderr copier on the same bytes.Buffer
defects.root_cause: startSyncHeartbeat wrote to the same io.Writer that exec.Cmd copied child stderr into, and stop only closed a channel without waiting for the goroutine
defects.fix: lockedWriter serializes both writers; stop waits for the heartbeat goroutine before returning

defects.title: Outbox database and WAL/SHM siblings were created with the process umask (0644)
defects.root_cause: SQLite creates its files with the process umask; the new read-only inspection correctly refused group/other-readable evidence but valid outboxes were not tightened at open
defects.fix: OpenOutbox chmods the database and its WAL/SHM siblings to 0600; read-only inspection still refuses accessible files

defects.title: Offline migration could rewrite a suffix the witness may already hold
defects.root_cause: runMigrate defaulted checkpointSeq to zero when no witness transport was configured and still proceeded
defects.fix: migrate requires a live witness checkpoint; the checkpoint sequence, hash, and witness fingerprint are verified under the pinned custodian set, bound into the signed migration proof, and recorded in the journal. A zero-value checkpoint is refused.

defects.title: Repair marker ABA: a same-reason contradiction during repair could be cleared
defects.root_cause: ClearRepairRequiredIfUnchanged compared only the reason string; MarkRepairRequired did not advance a monotonic revision
defects.fix: Every contradiction assertion advances repair_generation transactionally with the reason. Repair captures the generation before scanning and the CAS clears only when both reason and generation are unchanged.

defects.title: Cleanup intent was not demonstrably power-loss durable and could be skipped with no state directory
defects.root_cause: recordCleanupIntent used WriteFile+Rename without file/parent fsync, returned nil for an empty StateDir, and finishCleanup ignored clear failures
defects.fix: A durable state directory is mandatory; the intent is written with O_EXCL, fsynced, atomically renamed, and the parent directory is fsynced. Clear failures are surfaced in the result and leave the intent visible to PendingCleanupObligations.

defects.title: Release evidence bundle was not self-contained or portable
defects.root_cause: Attestation/SHA256SUMS used absolute source-host paths; the full-race log shipped in one package was truncated and did not match its recorded hash
defects.fix: Release paths are relative to the bundle; the attestation is signed over canonical JSON with a pinned Ed25519 root; a bundle verifier checks every attached log hash and rejects a truncated full-race log; the full-race log is copied into the bundle.

defects.title: The exact 20m full-tree race gate cannot pass: internal/cli alone exceeds 20m under -race
defects.root_cause: The internal/cli package has grown beyond the per-package budget; isolated profiling exceeded 20m before completion, and full-tree parallelism adds starvation
defects.fix: Per operator direction, the requalification gate raises the per-package budget to 30m and limits package parallelism (GOFLAGS=-p=4). The original 20m FAIL is retained in evidence; this is a budget/parallelism change, not a security waiver.

defects.title: The release-root private key was committed to the repository
defects.root_cause: sign-release-attestation.py read release-root.pem from inside the bundle, so the key material had to live in the tree; the committed key derived the pinned public key and could sign any attestation
defects.fix: The key is removed from the tree and gitignored; signing reads $RELEASE_ROOT_KEY outside the repository and refuses a key inside the bundle or any git worktree. The root was rotated and the attestation re-signed.
tests: sign-release-attestation.py refuses a key inside the bundle or a git worktree
git ls-files no longer lists any private key

defects.title: The attestation trust anchor was resolved from inside the bundle
defects.root_cause: verify-release-attestation.py loaded release-root.pub from the bundle and derived the expected key id from that same file, so a coherent substitution of key, attestation, canonical bytes and signature verified
defects.fix: Verification requires an externally supplied --root-key-id or --root and refuses without one; the bundled public key is a distribution copy checked against that pinned identity, never a source of it.
tests: negative-tests.sh forged-root case (new key + rewritten verdict + re-signed + replaced public key) is rejected

defects.title: The bundle verifier executed a verifier script taken from the bundle
defects.root_cause: verify-evidence-bundle.py ran <bundle>/verify-release-attestation.py, so replacing that file with a stub made the whole bundle report PASS
defects.fix: The verifier is resolved beside the bundle-verification tool and the anchor is passed through; the in-bundle copy is deleted.
tests: a stubbed in-bundle verifier is never executed

defects.title: Read-only preflight failed on a pre-upgrade journal schema
defects.root_cause: MigrationJournalPage selected every post-upgrade column while the additive ALTER only ran from writable OpenOutbox, so the mandatory preflight step failed with 'no such column' on exactly the databases the release migrates
defects.fix: Journal readers render their select list from PRAGMA table_info and substitute a typed default for an absent column; the upgrade still happens only on a writable open.

defects.title: Compensated coverage accepted a journal row without a verified signed transition
defects.root_cause: ResolveLegacyCoverage treated a consumed grant nonce as authorization but never verified the signed before/after proof, and the grant is not bound to a row, so a local database writer could copy a consumed grant and mint coverage
defects.fix: Compensated coverage requires VerifyMigrationProof under a pinned kernel-relay set and binds the proof's target sequence to the journal row; an unpinned or unverifiable proof stays UNRESOLVED.

defects.title: Migration could mint envelopes outside the pinned key-rotation window
defects.root_cause: Every rewritten row is re-signed with the current kernel-relay key; a suffix written under a retired key would be re-signed at indices before that key's ValidFromIndex, where Envelope.Verify refuses it
defects.fix: MigrateLegacySuffix refuses a suffix whose rows were signed by a different kernel-relay key and names the row, instead of producing history that cannot verify.

defects.title: custodyctl migrate read a database failure as an authoritative not-found
defects.root_cause: runMigrate quarantined on any Lookup error, turning a transient read failure into a durable unverifiable-legacy classification
defects.fix: Only sql.ErrNoRows means not-found; every other read error aborts the run.
tests: custodyctl migrate propagates a non-ErrNoRows lookup failure

defects.title: A stale cleanup-intent temp file wedged every later cleanup of the handle
defects.root_cause: recordCleanupIntent used O_EXCL on a deterministic temp path and never recovered a leftover from a crash between create and rename; PendingCleanupObligations ignored non-.json files
defects.fix: An existing temp file is removed and the create retried once, since the name is derived from this deployment's own handle.

defects.title: Qualification documents contradicted the matrix and the signed bundle
defects.root_cause: RESIDUAL-LIMITATIONS R7 still described lanes as BLOCKED after they ran, and the bundle README still reported UNSIGNED/NO-GO with a superseded archive hash
defects.fix: R7 now matches qualification-matrix.json; the README is regenerated from the signed attestation and states the pinned anchor and the exact verification command.

defects.title: A migration checkpoint was never verified at the library boundary
defects.root_cause: MigrateLegacySuffix accepted a CheckpointRef carrying only Seq/Hash/WitnessFP and tested WitnessFP for non-emptiness. custodyctl verified the checkpoint, but the library that performs the rewrite did not, so any caller — and any fingerprint string — authorized a durable evidence rewrite.
defects.fix: CheckpointRef now carries the custodian's signer epoch and signature, and Verify resolves it under the pinned custodian set. Migration authority moved from a bare checkpoint to a signed fence receipt that MigrateLegacySuffix verifies itself, requires to be OPEN, binds to this run's grant, and requires to freeze a head below the target.

defects.title: A checkpoint cannot prove that no submission is in flight, so a late submission forked custody
defects.root_cause: The witness accepted submissions purely against its own head. A submission already on the wire when the operator read the checkpoint landed while the rewrite was prepared, and the rewrite committed anyway; the witness then held the old bytes at a sequence the outbox had rewritten. Reproduced against the baseline as a permanent fork.
defects.fix: Migration epochs. The kernel asks the witness to freeze the deployment at the head it observed; the witness admits the fence only if that head is still its own and then refuses every submission until the epoch closes. The fence check, head read and insert share one immediate transaction, so a submission racing a fence-begin either commits before the freeze or is refused.

defects.title: The migration proof did not bind the journal row it described
defects.root_cause: migrationProof carried only TargetSeq, the checkpoint and before/after digests. Execution identity, terminal receipt digest, original/result envelope hashes, action and the rewritten rows were recorded in the journal but not covered by the signature, so a correctly signed proof could be attached to a different journal row.
defects.fix: The proof now binds action, row sequence, execution, terminal receipt digest, before/after envelope hashes and the frozen epoch, and verification re-derives both suffix digests from the proof's own rows. VerifyMigrationProofAgainstChain additionally re-proves a compensated entry against the evidence the outbox holds now.

defects.title: Kernel-relay proof trust was resolved from the custodian file
defects.root_cause: CustodyCoveragePolicy.ProofTrust was assigned the custodian trust set, and LoadTrustSet accepted a file pinning any mix of custodian, kernel-relay and repair-authority keys. One administrative document could hold all three authorities, and one key could be pinned as custodian and repair authority.
defects.fix: LoadTrustSetForRole refuses a file that pins any other role, CheckDisjointRoles refuses a key pinned under two authorities, the service requires CRABEDENCE_WITNESS_KERNEL_TRUST_ROOTS, and custodyctl takes three role-pinned files. The kernel set is the proof trust, never an alias for the custodian set.

defects.title: A fence abort could release an epoch after custody advanced
defects.root_cause: Abort was a state write with no comparison against the head the epoch froze, so an integrity fault inside a frozen window could be cleared by the recovery path that exists to handle crashes.
defects.fix: AbortFence compares the current head to the frozen base inside the transaction and returns a contradiction when custody moved. The epoch stays open for an operator.

defects.title: A crashed migration left no durable local record of its epoch
defects.root_cause: The epoch existed only at the witness. A kernel that crashed between freezing the custodian and recording anything could only re-open under a new grant, which the witness refuses while an epoch is open — custody stayed frozen with no nameable recovery.
defects.fix: custody_fence_intent records the planned epoch before the witness is asked to freeze. A re-run with the same grant finds the intent, re-enters the same fence identity idempotently, and custodyctl ships 'fence status' and 'fence abort' for the two terminal paths.

defects.title: The full-race gate was an operator-directed invocation, not a reproducible gate
defects.root_cause: G4a (exact 20m whole-tree) fails because internal/cli legitimately exceeds the shared per-package budget; G4b passed under GOFLAGS=-p=4 -timeout=45m, which records an operator decision rather than a measurement. Neither form is a gate.
defects.fix: scripts/qualify-race.sh is the canonical gate: every package runs in its own process with its own declared budget, in deterministic order, with per-package JSONL evidence and a summary. Parallelism is an explicit parameter rather than an environment accident.
tests: scripts/qualify-race.sh on internal/witness internal/custody cmd/custodyctl internal/execution internal/idempotency: 5 packages, 0 failed

open_items.title: msb has no atomic identity-conditioned delete; inspect-then-delete TOCTOU is narrowed but not eliminated
open_items.mitigation: second inspection + catalog dev/inode re-check + nonce-bound handle; documented in RESIDUAL-LIMITATIONS.md

open_items.title: A same-UID process that can write inside the verified catalog can modify runtime state in place
open_items.mitigation: dedicated owner-only catalog, no same-UID co-tenant; high-assurance claim is scoped to exclusive-runtime posture

open_items.title: Shared-runtime high-assurance cleanup is unsupported
open_items.mitigation: HighAssurance requires a non-empty namespace and a dedicated MSB_HOME; shared posture fails closed

open_items.title: Repair-authority key compromise grants full migration/repair authority until rotation
open_items.mitigation: separate key class, short grant windows, single-use nonces, pinned trust set, rotation authorization

open_items.title: The retired release-root private key remains in git history
open_items.mitigation: rotated to a new root held outside the repository; signatures under key id 387d837e… must be rejected. Purging the old blob from history requires a destructive rewrite and an explicit operator decision.

open_items.title: External trust-root authorization is unexecuted
open_items.mitigation: The release root is pinned by SHA-256 and its private key is held outside the repository, but a self-pinned root is not third-party authorization. No external countersignature exists for this candidate; the release claim does not include one.

open_items.title: No independently administered witness
open_items.mitigation: The fence lane runs against a second key in the same administrative domain, which the plan calls insufficient. Independent administration over authenticated TLS is unexecuted, so no third-party custody claim is made.

open_items.title: Third-party clean-room verification is unexecuted
open_items.mitigation: Local clean-room reproduction passes on the exact artifact; an external party has not reproduced or attested it.

open_items.title: Restricted deployment certification is unexecuted
open_items.mitigation: The macOS arm64/HVF exclusive-runtime profile is locally evidenced. An external assessor has not certified a restricted deployment.
